newsitem.title: USA: Danielson Holding Corp Q4 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Danielson Holding Corp Q4 loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Table figures are results from continuing operations.
1996 year net excludes loss from discontinued operations (including a loss on the disposal of Danielson Trust Co) of $1.9 million, or $0.12 per share.

1996 year and Q4 include increase of $10 million in unpaid losses and loss adjustment expenses for insurance subsidiary, National American Insurance Co of California, offset in part by $4 million reduction of an accrual for policyholder dividends, and previously announced expenses relating to the terminated Midland transaction and non-recurring compensation expenses of $3.1 million.
